evidence_source: CPA Act 2022 penalises port-area pollution; NOSCOP §5.1.1.8.1 gives ports immediate-response duty (Aiman 2025; MoEFCC 2020)
CPA Chairman sits on NOCS Committee; port duties defined (MoEFCC 2020, Part 4)
DoE fined the owner of tanker Desh-1 Tk 3 crore on 27 Oct 2019, two days after the Karnaphuli spill (Dhaka Tribune 2019; Samakal 2019)
adjudication_note: RAISED 1->2: enforcement is verified in a real port incident. Not 3: applied by DoE, case by case, and a comparable fine (Karnaphuli Dry Dock) was halved on appeal (TBS).
